brief: The next six weeks matter most for global health and EU diplomacy. The WHO pandemic annex (PABS) is not coming this year: IGWG9 ended on 13 November without a text and moved to formal rounds from January 2027, so I put the December special WHA at about 2%. Spain's snap election on 29 November is likely to produce a PP win that depends on Vox for a majority, and I put the EU's 2028–34 budget (MFF) deal at about 3% for the 26–27 November summit. I disagree with the crowd on Taipei: it prices Chiang Wan-an at 62%, and I say 80% because he is the KMT incumbent. The cheap tail-risk markets (pandemics, Iran regime change, a Ukraine peace deal) look fairly priced; the exceptions are Ukraine 'winning' and 'partial Crimea control', which I put at 10% against 27–30%.

events.title: COP31 — UN Climate Change Conference
events.expect: The summit part is over. Von der Leyen spoke, and the US, China and India were absent at leader level. Expect a late-running closing plenary with a general cover decision. A binding fossil-fuel transition roadmap is unlikely because the Turkish presidency favours implementation language.

calls.q: COP31 adopts an overarching cover decision by 22 November 2026
COP31 formally adopts a decision establishing a fossil-fuel transition roadmap by 22 November 2026

events.watch: Draft cover text circulated 18–19 November, and whether petrostates and the Arab Group block fossil language.

COP 31 Update 4: World leaders address climate summit in Antalya

events.title: WHO Director-General election — first candidates' forum
events.expect: The first candidates' forum should go ahead in Geneva as a scheduled, low-drama event. It matters as an early read on the field and on how candidates treat the PABS annex and WHO financing after the US exit. No decision is taken; the vote is at WHA80 in May 2027.

calls.q: The WHO Director-General candidates' forum takes place in Geneva on 19 November 2026

events.watch: A late candidate withdrawal, or a postponement notice from the WHO Secretariat.

events.title: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting
events.expect: Xi hosts in Shenzhen. A consensus leaders' declaration on trade and the economy is likely, since APEC usually manages one. I have not checked Trump's plans; he would more likely send a delegation or skip, given the G20 he hosts in December.

calls.q: APEC leaders issue a joint leaders' declaration by 20 November 2026
Donald Trump attends the APEC Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen in person

events.watch: White House travel announcements and any US–China summit scheduling around the meeting.

events.title: EU–Indonesia CEPA — formal signature targeted
events.expect: A signature on 21 November is a target, not a certainty. EU trade deals often slip on legal and Council procedure. I give signing by month-end slightly under even odds. It would be a rare EU trade win as tariff tensions persist.

calls.q: The EU–Indonesia CEPA is formally signed by 30 November 2026

events.watch: A Council decision on signature, or an official announcement of a signing ceremony.

events.title: Tweede Kamer — commissiedebat EU-Gezondheidsraad
events.expect: The committee debate ahead of the 8 December EPSCO (Health) will most likely go ahead. Committee debates are occasionally postponed, so I leave room for a reschedule. Expect the usual topics: pharma and critical-medicines files, EU health legislation and global health financing.

calls.q: The Tweede Kamer commissiedebat EU-Gezondheidsraad takes place on 25 November 2026

events.watch: A change in the Kamer's agenda or a cancellation notice in the days before.

events.title: Special European Council on the MFF 2028–2034
events.expect: No deal. The MFF needs unanimity, and net payers, cohesion and farm-aid recipients, and the new-own-resources question remain far apart. Expect a leaders' discussion and instructions to continue, with real bargaining pushed into 2027.

calls.q: EU leaders reach political agreement on the 2028–2034 MFF by 27 November 2026

events.watch: A revised negotiating box with figures, or Commission or Council signals of a fast compromise.

events.title: Taiwan — local elections (nine-in-one)
events.expect: The KMT should hold Taipei and do well overall, as in 2022 when it took most local executive posts. I have not seen fresh Taipei polling. I put incumbent Chiang Wan-an well above the 62% crowd price on incumbency and the city's lean.

calls.q: Chiang Wan-an wins the Taipei mayoral election on 28 November 2026
The KMT wins more city and county top posts than the DPP in the 28 November 2026 local elections

events.watch: Late Taipei polls showing the DPP within 5 points, or a scandal hitting Chiang.

events.title: Palestine — legislative election
events.expect: I could not verify preparations, and Palestinian votes have a long record of slipping. Gaza voting is very unlikely under current conditions, and candidate eligibility rules are contested. I make it slightly better than a coin flip that West Bank voting happens on the date.

calls.q: Voting in the Palestinian legislative election takes place in the West Bank on 28 November 2026
Voting in the Palestinian legislative election also takes place in the Gaza Strip by 30 November 2026

events.watch: Postponement decree from the Palestinian Authority or the Central Elections Commission.

events.title: Spain — snap general election
events.expect: The PP wins the most seats; polls put PP plus Vox at roughly 190–200 of 350, but the PP needs Vox to govern. The PSOE is polling at about 105–108 seats in the surveys I saw. Investiture before year-end is very unlikely because the Cortes only convene in late December.

calls.q: The PP wins the most seats in the 29 November 2026 Spanish general election
PP and Vox together win at least 176 of 350 seats in the 29 November 2026 election
Alberto Núñez Feijóo wins a parliamentary investiture vote as prime minister by 31 December 2026

events.watch: Late polls showing PP+Vox under 176, or a PSOE surge after the Toledo train crash.

events.title: IGWG — reserved dates for further PABS annex meetings (as needed)
events.expect: These reserved dates will almost certainly go unused. After IGWG9, WHO says formal talks resume on 11–15 January 2027, with more rounds in February and March, and the target is WHA80 in May 2027. A December special session to adopt the annex is therefore also off.

calls.q: No formal IGWG negotiating meeting on the PABS annex is held between 30 November and 4 December 2026
A special session of the World Health Assembly adopts the PABS annex by 15 December 2026

events.watch: Any WHO notice convening additional IGWG sessions or an Executive Board call for a special WHA.

sources.title: Member States reiterate commitment to finalize Pandemic Agreement PABS Annex by May 2027
The Missing Annex: Pathogen Sharing and the Unfinished WHO Pandemic Agreement

events.title: The Gambia — presidential election
events.expect: Incumbent Adama Barrow is the favourite in a plurality, one-round contest against a split opposition. I have not checked recent polling, so I leave real room for a surprise. A disputed result is a smaller risk than in many West African votes.

calls.q: Adama Barrow is declared winner of the 5 December 2026 Gambian presidential election by 9 December 2026

events.watch: Opposition consolidation behind one candidate, or a candidacy ruling against Barrow.

events.title: G20 Leaders' Summit
events.expect: Trump hosts a slimmed-down summit at Doral. A leaders' text is possible but not assured, because the US has narrowed the agenda and has excluded South Africa. Health and climate language is likely thin or absent.

calls.q: The G20 Leaders' Summit takes place at Doral on 14–15 December 2026 with Donald Trump present
A joint leaders' declaration is issued at the end of the 2026 G20 Leaders' Summit

events.watch: Sherpa reports of a draft declaration, and the final invitation list, including South Africa.
